Sparse Volume Textures in Unreal Engine | Unreal Engine 5.8 ... - Epic Dev
Sparse Volume Textures An asset that stores baked simulation data representing volumetric media, such as smoke, fire, and water. Learn to use this Experimental feature, but use caution when shipping with it. A Sparse Volume Texture (SVT) is a texture that stores texels (voxels) in a 3D data structure.
